name: SizeGuide
usage_hint: Modal size chart with metric/imperial toggle. Trigger button opens overlay table with size measurements.
when_to_use: On apparel, footwear, or gear product pages. Shows measurement table (chest, waist, length, etc.) in modal. Optional unit toggle (cm/inches) and measurement tip. Trigger is inline link/button.
when_not_to_use: For products without size variations. When sizes are standard (S/M/L with no measurement chart). For size recommender tools (this is static chart, not AI fitting).
anti_patterns: Providing incomplete size data (missing sizes or measurements breaks trust)
Using generic size chart for products with different fits (oversized vs slim — needs separate charts)
Not including measurement tip (customers don't know how to measure themselves)

examples.label: Apparel size guide with unit toggle
examples.source:
<lx-island name="SizeGuide">
  <script type="application/json">{"title":"Size Guide","headers":["Size","Chest","Waist","Length"],"rows":[{"size":"Small","chest":"34-36\"","waist":"28-30\"","length":"28\""},{"size":"Medium","chest":"38-40\"","waist":"32-34\"","length":"29\""},{"size":"Large","chest":"42-44\"","waist":"36-38\"","length":"30\""}],"units":{"metric":"cm","imperial":"inches"},"tip":"Measure around the fullest part of your chest"}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Footwear size chart
examples.source:
<lx-island name="SizeGuide">
  <script type="application/json">{"title":"Shoe Size Chart","headers":["US Size","UK Size","EU Size","Foot Length"],"rows":[{"size":"8","uk size":"7","eu size":"41","foot length":"26cm"},{"size":"9","uk size":"8","eu size":"42","foot length":"27cm"}],"tip":"Measure from heel to longest toe"}</script>
</lx-island>

examples.label: Simple size guide without units
examples.source:
<lx-island name="SizeGuide">
  <script type="application/json">{"title":"Fit Guide","headers":["Size","Fits Height","Fits Weight"],"rows":[{"size":"S","fits height":"5'4\"-5'7\"","fits weight":"120-140 lbs"},{"size":"M","fits height":"5'7\"-5'10\"","fits weight":"140-165 lbs"}]}</script>
</lx-island>
